_comment: Performance budgets for the landing (yantra4d.com). ONE source of truth: the CI bundle step, the Lighthouse CI budget, the Playwright e2e assertions and the prerender pipeline all read this file. Bytes are TRANSFER sizes (brotli for text over Cloudflare; gzip is the CI proxy, ~10% larger) unless a key says otherwise. Plan of record: internal-devops docs/strategy/2026-09-18-yantra4d-landing-revamp-plan.md §3.6.

transfer._comment: initialJs = every script the page requests before the 3D chunk (islands + their static import closure). Measured 2026-09-19 after the island diet: 60 KB brotli, of which 51 KB is vendor-react (react-dom), a floor set by the mandatory @madfam/ecosystem-banner island; the gallery island itself is 4 KB and three.js is deferred. The plan's 40 KB figure assumed the banner could be React-free — tracked as a Phase 2 follow-up; until then 64 KB is the honest gate. threeChunk = the lazily imported bundle carrying three + R3F + drei + the meshopt decoder, loaded after LCP and only on tier >= lite. fullScroll = everything a full scroll to the footer transfers, per tier.

runtime._comment: frameP95Ms at the tier's DPR cap; the governor (Phase 2) demotes above governorDemoteMs.

images._comment: Per-thumbnail budget (public/projects/<slug>.webp), enforced by scripts/dev/optimize-landing-thumbnails.mjs and src/test/landing-thumbnails.test.ts. Cards render at most 640 px wide.

meshes._comment: Per-file budgets the prerender pipeline enforces (meshopt-compressed GLB on disk).

exceptions._comment: Per-cartridge overrides of the block above, each with a written reason. The optimizer applies an override to that slug's target only and records it on the manifest entry (`budget`), so a cap kept by exception is never mistaken for one kept outright. Remove an entry when its reason no longer holds.

implicit-lattice-hyperobject.reason: A lattice: 359,268 triangles simplify to a floor of 12,365 (28,316 B) before the struts collapse, so the 12,288 B lod1 cap is unreachable from this render. The right fix is a smaller preview instance (fewer cells), which needs per-cartridge preview parameters in the pipeline; until then the model ships at 28 KB rather than the card losing its 3D preview (2026-09-19, prerender run 35460054814).

lighthouse._comment: Category scores are 0-1 in Lighthouse CI assertions; kept here as percentages for humans.
